info.title: Dumpling - .NET Memory Dump Analyzer
info.description: A delightful CLI tool and stdio MCP server for analyzing .NET memory dumps (.gcdump and process dumps). Provides heap analysis, type statistics, retained size calculations, string duplicate detection, object inspection, memory leak detection, interactive mode, and AI-agent MCP tools.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
🥟 Dumpling - A delightful CLI tool for analyzing .NET memory dumps

Recipes:
  dumpling analyze heap.gcdump --suspects
  dumpling analyze heap.gcdump --suspects --dominators -t 15
  dumpling analyze dump.dmp --duplicates --top-strings 20
  dumpling compare before.gcdump after.gcdump --suspects --why-grew
  dumpling analyze heap.gcdump --interactive
  dumpling ps && dumpling collect -p <pid> --kind heap

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: analyze
commands.description: Analyze a heap dump file or a live process

options.name: --top-types
options.description: Number of top types to display [default: 20]

options.name: --interactive
options.description: Launch interactive mode [default: False]

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format [default: Table]

options.name: --show-instances
options.description: Show sample instances for each type [default: False]

options.name: --show-retainers
options.description: Show retainer paths for top instances (implies --show-instances) [default: False]

options.name: --max-instances
options.description: Maximum instances to show per type when --show-instances is used [default: 3]

options.name: --filter
options.description: Regex filter for type names (case-insensitive)

options.name: --sample-nodes
options.description: If the dump has more nodes than this, sample the graph down (GraphSampler) for faster analysis. Counts are scaled back to full-heap estimates.

options.name: --min-retained
options.description: Only include types with retained size ≥ this (bytes or human size: 1mb, 512k, 1048576)

options.name: --min-count
options.description: Only include types with instance count ≥ this value [default: 0]

options.name: --suspects
options.description: Run automatic leak-suspect heuristics (dominators, heavy holders, arrays, root hotspots) [default: False]

options.name: --group-by-retention
options.description: Group instances of matching types by retention-path shape (similar retention) [default: False]

options.name: --retention-types
options.description: When using --group-by-retention, number of top types to cluster (default: 3) [default: 3]

options.name: --max-paths
options.description: Max reference paths per instance (default: 1 = hot path only) [default: 1]

options.name: --dominators
options.description: Show top dominators (objects ranked by exclusive retained size) and expand the largest [default: False]

options.name: --show-outgoing
options.description: Show outgoing references (what objects hold) for sample instances / top types [default: False]

options.name: --top-strings
options.description: Show top N unique string values by total shallow size (process dump / ClrMD only)

options.name: --duplicates
options.description: Group duplicate System.String instances by content (process dump / ClrMD only) [default: False]

options.name: --search-strings
options.description: Search string object content (substring; process dump / ClrMD only)

options.name: --search-regex
options.description: Treat --search-strings as a regular expression [default: False]

options.name: --min-string-count
options.description: Minimum instance count for string groups (default: 1; duplicates default floor 2) [default: 1]

options.name: --min-string-bytes
options.description: Minimum total shallow size for string groups (bytes or human size: 64k, 1mb)

options.name: --string-preview
options.description: Max characters of string content to show (0 = hide content) [default: 80]

options.name: --max-strings-scan
options.description: Max System.String instances to scan for content analysis (0 = unlimited) [default: 500000]

options.name: --pid
options.description: Analyze a live process by PID (snapshot or collect, see --kind)

options.name: --process
options.description: Analyze a live process by name (must be unique)

options.name: --kind
options.description: Live-attach mode: snapshot (ClrMD, default for string features), gcdump (structure), heap/full (write dump then analyze)

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: Path to a .gcdump or process dump (.dmp / core). Optional when --pid / --process is set.

commands.name: compare
commands.description: Compare multiple heap dump files to identify changes and memory growth

options.name: --interactive
options.description: Launch interactive mode for exploring comparison results [default: False]

options.name: --select-files
options.description: Launch interactive file selection when multiple files are found [default: False]

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format [default: Table]

options.name: --top-types
options.description: Number of top changed types to display [default: 20]

options.name: --threshold
options.description: Minimum change percentage to display (0.01 = 1%) [default: 0.01]

options.name: --show-all
options.description: Show all types including unchanged ones [default: False]

options.name: --sort-by
options.description: Sort by: RetainedSizeDelta (growth first, default), CountDelta, TotalSizeDelta, GrowthPercent [default: RetainedSizeDelta]

options.name: --filter
options.description: Regex filter for type names (case-insensitive)

options.name: --min-retained
options.description: Only include types whose current retained size ≥ this (bytes or 1mb/512k; Added/Removed always included)

options.name: --min-count
options.description: Only include types whose current instance count ≥ this value (Added/Removed always included) [default: 0]

options.name: --suspects
options.description: Highlight growth-based leak suspects (added / grown types) [default: False]

options.name: --why-grew
options.description: For top grown/added types, cluster current-dump instances by retention path (why they stay alive) [default: False]

options.name: --why-grew-types
options.description: How many grown types to explain with --why-grew (default: 5) [default: 5]

options.name: --strings
options.description: Compare string content profiles (process dumps only; top growing/shrinking string groups) [default: False]

arguments.name: FILES
arguments.description: Paths to .gcdump or process dumps (.dmp) to compare (2 or more), or a directory containing dumps

commands.name: ps
commands.description: List .NET processes that can be attached for dump collection

commands.name: collect
commands.description: Collect a heap dump from a running .NET process

options.name: --pid
options.description: Process ID to collect from

options.name: --process
options.description: Process name (must be unique among published .NET processes)

options.name: --kind
options.description: Dump kind: gcdump (structure), heap (ClrMD strings), full [default: heap]

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file path (or directory). Default: ./dumpling_<kind>_<pid>_<timestamp>.*

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: Run Dumpling as a stdio MCP server for AI agents
